messages:
isabel: Heads-up: launching a small gated preview for G200 Ultra Dedicated pools in Dublin (DUB) and Warsaw (WAW) next Wednesday 09:00 local. Purpose: high-throughput generative workloads with improved transient memory handling. Pilot customers only, capacity is intentionally small.

mike: Quick policy note: we’re introducing priority_tiers for this preview (gold/silver/bronze). Gold gets higher steady throughput and larger burst windows; silver has smaller burst allowance; bronze runs best-effort. PMs will propose pilot accounts into tiers. :trophy: 

jordan: Ops details: burst policy uses a per-tenant token bucket and a new "priority_boost" flag. Default burst_window=4m. Gold: priority_boost=1.5, silver=1.2, bronze=1.0. When tokens exhausted, we fall back to baseline qps.

infra-bot: Runbook published: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/g200-ultra-preview (internal) :link: 

mike: Console/CLI: Dedicated > Pools > G200 Ultra (preview) has a tier selector and a burst toggle. CLI sample: 
```
redwood pools reserve --pool g200-dub --capacity 2 --tier gold --burst-window 240
```

isabel: Billing: preview customers billed at 50% of GA reserved rate. No SLA in preview. We will tag usage with "g200_preview_tier" so finance and customers can see tiered consumption.

billing: Confirmed. We’ll emit a tier breakdown in the next invoice and add a Console Cost filter for g200_preview_tier.

jordan: Runtime note: G200 needs runtime shim 4.5.x+ and driver 9.0.x. Private customers must upgrade control plane components before routing; upgrade checklist in runbook. Also watch for a small fp16-to-bf16 conversion mismatch we observed on a corner-case eval.

mike: Migration guidance: run small canaries, enable prefix KV caching, set request_timeouts=100s for long-context models, and use the autoscaling tag "scale_on_burst" for non-critical workloads. We will auto-fallback to L40e/GPU-compat pools when G200 capacity is exhausted.

isabel: Pilot nomination process: PMs/SEs, DM me account ids + desired tier. Ops will allocate daytime reservation windows and one nightly buffer slot per pilot. If you’re on-call for DUB/WAW that week, please review the runbook.

jordan: Dashboards: added Dedicated > Pools > G200 Ultra (preview) -> metrics: p95_latency, burst_token_fill, tier_evictions, and kv_cache_hit. Alerts: tier_evictions > 5 in 10m triggers ops paging.

isabel: TL;DR: G200 Ultra preview in Dublin & Warsaw, priority tiers + burst_token policy, preview billing and no SLA, runbook/CLI/console flags live. Ping me or ops to nominate pilots. :sparkles:
